text: 最近我周围有好几个朋友都对此发表了他们的看法，我听一听，也是很感慨的。
en: Recently several friends around me have shared their views on this, and listening to them, I find it quite thought-provoking.

text: 他们的观点如下（括号中是我的体会）：
en: Their views are as follows (the bracketed parts are my own reflections):

text: A：没有时间慢慢变富了。
en: A: There is no longer time to get rich slowly.

text: （是的，时间已经不站在你这边，复利最珍贵的就是时间，可惜，已经不属于你。
en: (Yes, time is no longer on your side; what compound interest cherishes most is time, yet, alas, it no longer belongs to you.

text: 本金决不能受损，一旦大错，再无翻盘的机会）
en: Your principal must never be lost; once a grave mistake is made, there is no chance of a comeback)

text: B：很多事还没干，已经没有时间干了。
en: B: There are many things left undone, and already no time to do them.

text: （年轻时候，什么都可以试一试，学习是最重要的，40岁必须做减法，该考虑收获了，人生没有无限的青春）
en: (In youth, one could try anything; learning was paramount. By forty you must practise subtraction — it is time to think about harvesting. Life does not grant unlimited youth.)

text: C：一转眼人生过半，一直忙于工作，思考人生是不是要这样度过，那些想去的地方还没去，想体验的事情还没体验。
en: C: In the blink of an eye, half a lifetime has passed; forever busy with work, I wonder whether life should be spent this way — the places I wanted to visit remain unvisited, the experiences I wished to have remain unhad.

text: （谁不想早点退休？
en: (Who would not want to retire early?

text: 我也人到中年，这是个多么沉重的话题，甚至我都觉得自己不再年轻，和那些20多的小朋友一起上班，无限感叹青春的可贵！
en: I too have reached middle age, and what a heavy subject this is; I even feel myself no longer young, working alongside those twenty-somethings, endlessly sighing at how precious youth is!

text: 天真无邪是青春的专属权力，可以肆意的挥霍，一切都有无限的可能。
en: Innocence is the exclusive privilege of youth, to be squandered recklessly, for with it everything holds infinite possibility.

text: 我再不能说，我不在乎钱，我更在意这个机会。
en: I can no longer say that I do not care about money and care more about the opportunity.

text: 我必须在意钱，不然这就不是个好机会，毫无办法。
en: I must care about money, otherwise it is not a good opportunity at all — there is nothing to be done.

text: 我也不再拥有自由选择的权力，并不是每个选择我都能承担试错的成本，所以必须权衡利弊，谨慎行事。
en: I no longer possess the power of free choice; I cannot bear the cost of trial and error for every option, so I must weigh the pros and cons and proceed with caution.

text: 我会很注重健康，因为我上有老下有小，责任重大。
en: I pay great attention to my health, because I have ageing parents above and young children below, and heavy responsibilities.

text: 我的精力在衰减。
en: My energy is in decline.

text: 所以如何分配我的精力，更好的休息，也成为了计划的一部分。
en: So how to allocate my energy and rest better has also become part of the plan.

text: 而年轻的时候，精力好到爆炸，似乎无穷无尽！
en: Yet in youth, my energy was explosive, seemingly boundless!

text: 唯一还行的，就是我还是很喜欢玩，对各种各样的事情感兴趣。
en: The only thing still going for me is that I still very much enjoy playing and remain interested in all sorts of things.

text: 这可能是我为数不多觉得自己还年轻的依据。
en: This is perhaps one of the few grounds on which I still feel young.

text: 希望我能爱玩的久一点，一直玩下去。
en: I hope I can keep my love of play for a little longer, and keep playing always.

text: 82年，正好妥妥的40岁。
en: Born in '82, I have just comfortably turned forty.

text: 也就是到了今年，才突然发现自己的年龄已经上4字头了。
en: It was only this year that I suddenly realised my age had crossed into the forties.

text: 40岁，除了数字比较有象征意义，其他真的暂时还没觉得有啥大的变化。
en: At forty, apart from the number being rather symbolic, I genuinely do not yet feel any great change in anything else.

text: 也许是因为，我在二十岁的时候，就开始装深沉的缘故，所以一路活到现在，反而感觉越活越年轻。
en: Perhaps it is because I began putting on a show of depth at twenty, so having lived this way till now, I instead feel younger the older I get.

text: 比如，二十岁的时候，我都不会追姑娘，我会美其名曰没有好姑娘值得我追，那些姑娘也确实看不上我，而我却装的我很清高的样子，骨子里却充满了自卑。
en: For instance, at twenty I did not even know how to court girls; I would dress it up nicely, claiming no good girl was worth my pursuit, and those girls indeed looked down on me, yet I put on an air of being above it all, while deep down I was full of inferiority.

text: 四十岁了，我经历了不下三十多个女人，短的一个月，长的两三年，有过轰轰烈烈刻骨铭心的，也有玩得不开心就立马散伙的，总之我学会了跪舔，装逼，有我追到手的，有把我追到手的，也有同一时期里同时有着好几个女人。
en: At forty, I have been with no fewer than thirty-odd women — some for a month, some for two or three years; there were passionate, unforgettable affairs, and there were those I broke up with the moment the fun stopped. In short, I learned to play the sycophant and the poser; some I chased into my arms, some chased me into theirs, and there were times I had several women at once.

text: 二十岁的时候，住亲戚家破房子里，寄人篱下，还要看长辈脸色决定晚上要不要出去跑步，因为他们会担心我在这么大的城市里迷路或找不良伙伴。
en: At twenty, I lived in a run-down house at a relative's, dependent on their hospitality, and still had to read my elders' faces to decide whether I could go out for a run at night, because they worried I might get lost in such a big city or fall in with bad company.

text: 找工作，大夏天汗流浃背去推销某大厂的ip电话机，到处吃闭门羹还被循循教导要努力。
en: Job-hunting, in the height of summer I dripped with sweat peddling some big firm's IP phones, met with closed doors everywhere, and was patiently lectured to work hard.

text: 四十岁，真正体会到努力有鸟用，方向不对努力就是个屁。
en: At forty, I truly realise that hard work is of no bloody use; get the direction wrong and effort is just a fart.

text: 人活着，永远是看势的能力和运的眷顾，仅此而已。
en: To live is forever a matter of the ability to read the tide and the favour of fortune — nothing more.

text: 二十岁的时候，不知道为啥而学习，以为读书好就会有回报，其实读书再好，学历再牛逼，也就是个好用点的工具人而已。
en: At twenty, I did not know why I studied, assuming good grades would bring reward; yet however well you read, however impressive the degree, you are merely a slightly more useful tool-person.

text: 工资再高，也不够你买城市的一个厕所。
en: However high the salary, it is not enough to buy a single toilet in the city.

text: 四十岁，喜欢看自己想看的书，不为求任何回报或效果，仅仅因为有趣就可以。
en: At forty, I like to read whatever books I fancy, seeking no reward or effect whatsoever, simply because they are interesting.

text: 道德经，庄子，超级喜欢，顺便还翻了资本论，总想搞明白到底啥是资本主义和共产主义，毛选，除了官方版还搜集了官方没印的版…
en: The Tao Te Ching and Zhuangzi — I adore them; I also flipped through Capital along the way, always wanting to work out what on earth capitalism and communism really are. As for the Selected Works of Mao, besides the official editions I also collected versions the authorities never printed…

text: 二十岁，生个病怕去医院，总觉得挂不住脸，一天到晚被莆田系广告轰炸，明明没有性生活却被忽悠成性病，榨干过两个月工资。
en: At twenty, falling ill I feared the hospital, always feeling I could not save face; bombarded day and night by Putian-chain advertisements, I was perfectly chaste yet tricked into thinking I had a venereal disease, and had two months' wages squeezed out of me.

text: 四十岁，运动能力保持还行，每天内练一口气外炼筋骨皮一点不担心生什么病，半年一体检，有病治病一点不含糊。
en: At forty, my athletic ability is still decent; I train my breath within and my sinews and skin without every day and worry not a whit about falling ill. I have a check-up every six months, and if there is an ailment I treat it without the slightest equivocation.

text: 二十岁以为有一个女人一定会从一而终，四十岁，觉得人最终总会成为一个人…
en: At twenty I believed one woman would stay with me for life; at forty, I feel a person ultimately always becomes a solitary one…

text: 二十岁以为爱情很美好，四十岁认为女人很美好。
en: At twenty I thought love was beautiful; at forty I believe women are beautiful.

text: 二十岁以为不经历风雨怎么见彩虹，四十岁才知道md彩虹其实就在那，风雨可以是人造的…
en: At twenty I believed one cannot see the rainbow without weathering the storm; at forty I finally know, bloody hell, that the rainbow is right there, and the storm can be man-made…

text: 四十岁，该活的通透点了。
en: At forty, one ought to live with a bit more clarity.

text: 88年，卷王省份，体制内，目前对什么都不感兴趣。
en: Born in '88, in a hyper-competitive province, within the system, and currently interested in nothing at all.

text: 人到中年，不再执着于强求，也不再纠结于对错。
en: Having reached middle age, I no longer cling to forcing things, nor do I agonise over right and wrong.

text: 褪去了年少的锋芒，学会了沉默与包容。
en: I have shed the sharp edges of youth and learned silence and tolerance.

text: 肩上扛着责任，心里藏着委屈，却依旧学着温柔待人、安稳度日，懂得健康是最大的财富，心安是最好的归宿。
en: Shouldering responsibility, hiding grievances within, yet still learning to treat others gently and live steadily, understanding that health is the greatest wealth and peace of mind the best harbour.

text: 前阵子在网上看到一句话：大部分中年人都还意识不到，你在外人眼里有多老，都还认为自己很年轻。
en: Not long ago I saw a line online: most middle-aged people are still unaware of how old they look in others' eyes, and still consider themselves very young.

text: 尤其是像我家两口子这种少年夫妻开始的，感觉二十年如一日，看对方都没什么变化，或者说根本感觉不到这种变化。
en: Especially for a couple like us, who began as teenage sweethearts; it feels as if twenty years passed like a single day, and looking at each other we see no change — or rather, simply cannot perceive such change.

text: 直到今年儿子要报名初中了，拿出一堆证件办手续，翻到结婚证，这才震惊，结婚证上的脸简直就像是我们现在走在路上眼里看到会判断成孩子的脸！
en: It was only when our son was enrolling in junior secondary this year, and we pulled out a pile of documents to handle the paperwork, flipping to the marriage certificate, that we were shocked: the faces on that certificate looked exactly like the faces we would now glance at on the street and judge to be children!

text: 原来现在真是老了好多。
en: So we really have aged a great deal.

text: 但可怕的不是外表老了，而是身体告诉我们，真的不一样了，没想到中年是如此脆皮。
en: But what is frightening is not the ageing appearance, but that the body tells us it is genuinely different — I never expected middle age to be so fragile.

text: 生出这样的感慨，是因为最近我们夫妻身体都有了各种小问题。
en: The reason for such reflections is that recently both my wife and I have developed various minor health problems.

text: 先是经历了G先生治胃病的过程。
en: It began with experiencing Mr G's process of treating his stomach ailment.

text: G先生的胃不怎么好，算是老问题了，他为了暑假里去旅游能好好享受到美食，所以这次打算去看医生好好治一治。
en: Mr G's stomach has never been great — an old problem. So that he could properly enjoy good food on his summer holiday trip, he decided this time to see a doctor and get it properly treated.

text: 于是做了个胃镜。
en: And so he had a gastroscopy.

text: 做无痛胃镜是全麻的，需要有家人陪护。
en: A painless gastroscopy requires general anaesthesia and a family member to accompany and care for the patient.

text: 整个过程确实没多少痛苦，除了做之前需要喝一小瓶药水，他说那个超级难喝。
en: The whole process was indeed not very painful, except that beforehand he had to drink a small vial of liquid medicine, which he said tasted absolutely vile.

text: 做起来也很快，没几分钟就结束了，做完也不会觉得难受，苏醒也没几分钟，只是麻药刚过去那一会儿会晕晕乎乎的，跟个醉汉一样。
en: The procedure itself was quick, over in a few minutes; afterwards he felt no discomfort, and came round within minutes — only in the brief spell just after the anaesthetic wore off did he feel groggy, like a drunkard.

text: 可看到他们做完之后躺在病床上被推到观察室的样子，还是多少有点令人难受的。
en: Yet seeing them, after the procedure, lying on hospital beds being wheeled to the observation room, was still somewhat unsettling.

text: 他们都侧躺在床上，微微蜷曲，脑袋下都放着一块毛巾，应该是接口水用的。
en: They all lay on their sides, slightly curled up, with a towel placed under each head — presumably to catch the drool.

text: 他们嘴里都塞着一个扩口器，用宽皮筋套到后脑勺固定，鼻子里塞着氧气管，闭着眼睛毫无知觉。
en: In their mouths was wedged a mouth gag, fixed to the back of the head with a wide elastic band; oxygen tubes were inserted in their nostrils; their eyes were shut, utterly unconscious.

text: 两三张床一模一样地躺在那儿，就跟某种实验品似的。
en: Two or three beds lay there in identical fashion, like some kind of specimens.

text: 这场景，让我莫名想起自己生孩子的时候，裸着下身躺在待产室病床上，刚被破了水，紧张得浑身直抖又还在一遍遍阵痛时候的样子。
en: This scene inexplicably reminded me of when I gave birth: lying naked from the waist down on the bed in the delivery room, just after my waters had been broken, trembling all over with nervousness while the labour pains came again and again.

text: 总之，都很没有尊严就是了，跟待宰的羔羊没什么两样。
en: In short, it was all utterly undignified — no different from lambs awaiting slaughter.

text: 而普通胃镜则看起来更可怕，从那个诊室出来的人都一边走一边吐。
en: An ordinary gastroscopy, by contrast, looked even more dreadful: those coming out of that consulting room vomited as they walked.

text: 有个大娘说，羡慕做无痛胃镜的，可惜70以上就不能做无痛了，真的吃苦头。
en: An old lady said she envied those having the painless gastroscopy; pity that above seventy you can no longer have the painless one — they really suffer.

text: 好在G先生胃镜检查出来没什么大毛病，浅表性胃炎估计是基操，还有反酸的问题需要吃点药。
en: Thankfully Mr G's gastroscopy revealed nothing seriously wrong; superficial gastritis is probably standard issue, and there is also acid reflux that needs some medication.

text: 然而G先生是真的脆皮，回来没两天就开始发烧了，他说自己应是做胃镜受凉了。
en: Yet Mr G is genuinely fragile; within two days of returning he started running a fever, which he said was surely from catching a chill during the gastroscopy.

text: 倒也很有可能，因为那天正好下大雨，并不热，做胃镜的时候医生让把外套脱了，他便只穿了短袖，在观察室的时候还开着空调，即便给他盖上了外套，估计也还是冷的，毕竟外套很薄，他又睡着。
en: That is quite possible, because it rained heavily that day and was not warm; during the gastroscopy the doctor told him to take his coat off, so he wore only a short-sleeved shirt, and in the observation room the air conditioning was on. Even with his coat laid over him, he was probably still cold — after all the coat was thin and he was asleep.

text: 至于我自己，虽然经过一年半的恢复，体质已经好了很多，但还是不够精力充沛，不论是教练，还是偶尔去探店的瑜伽老师，都说我力气太小肌肉无力。
en: As for myself, although after a year and a half of recovery my constitution has improved greatly, I still lack energy; both the coach and the yoga instructor at the studio I occasionally drop in on say my strength is too little and my muscles weak.

text: 这就意味着，我还是干不动活儿，动不动就累。
en: This means I still cannot manage physical work, and tire at the slightest thing.

text: 更令我烦恼的是，前阵子跟闺蜜聊天，聊到血脂的问题，我就说起自己血脂也高，然后我翻出这两年的两次检查记录，就发现血脂指数是一次比一次高。
en: What troubles me more is that not long ago, chatting with my close friend, the subject of blood lipids came up; I mentioned my own were also high, then pulled out my two check-up records from these past two years and found the blood lipid levels rising each time.

text: 而且是总胆固醇和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇这两项高，尤其是低密度脂蛋白胆固醇一次比一次高可不是好事。
en: And it is specifically total cholesterol and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol that are high; in particular, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol climbing each time is no good thing.

text: 于是我又去医院复查了一次，结果更高了…
en: So I went back to hospital for another check, and the result was even higher…

text: 把我整得吃饭都不香了好几天。
en: It put me off my food for several days.

text: 医生的诊断是目前还不需要吃药，又说我这个问题跟吃东西其实关系不大，也没什么办法降低。
en: The doctor's diagnosis was that for now I do not yet need medication, and added that my problem is not actually much related to diet, nor is there any good way to lower it.

text: 但又关照我不能吃动物内脏了。
en: But he did tell me to stop eating animal offal.

text: 我自己网上查了查，貌似也只能多运动，再吃健康些，别的健康作息我反正一直挺健康的。
en: I looked it up online myself; apparently all I can do is exercise more and eat a bit healthier. As for other healthy habits, I have always been fairly healthy anyway.

text: 最后我只能安慰自己，实在不行就吃药呗，也没什么大不了。
en: In the end I could only console myself: if all else fails, I'll just take the medicine — it is no big deal.

text: 而我最爱的美食，也只能没那么享受了。
en: And the foods I love most, I can only enjoy a little less.

text: 你看，中年人就是如此脆皮。
en: You see, middle-aged people are just this fragile.

text: 身上的结节、囊肿，那都已经不算什么了，毕竟不痛不痒没有存在感，我们闺蜜几个人人都有，就是那些无法忽视的、需要天天注意饮食养生的小毛病都开始陆续找上我们了。
en: Nodules and cysts on the body — those no longer count for much, being painless and without presence; every one of us close friends has them. It is those impossible-to-ignore minor ailments, the ones demanding daily attention to diet and wellness, that have begun to come for us one by one.

text: 还有我朋友圈里的J先生和L先生。
en: Then there are Mr J and Mr L in my social-media circle.

text: 他们都是老板级别，跟我们同龄，一个得了高血压，一个得了高血糖，开始了每天嗑药的中老年养生生活，还得努力工作。
en: They are both boss-level, the same age as us; one has high blood pressure, the other high blood sugar, and they have begun a middle-aged regimen of popping pills daily while still having to work hard.

text: 根据2023年《中国城市白领健康状况白皮书》显示，1980-1985年龄段人群中：
en: According to the 2023 China Urban White-Collar Health Status White Paper, among those born in 1980–1985:

text: • 78.6%存在颈椎/腰椎问题
en: • 78.6% have cervical/lumbar spine problems

text: • 63.4%有长期失眠症状
en: • 63.4% suffer from chronic insomnia

text: • 高血压检出率较10年前同年龄段上升42%
en: • hypertension detection rate is 42% higher than for the same age group ten years ago

text: （来源：中国医师协会健康管理与健康保险专业委员会）
en: (Source: Committee on Health Management and Health Insurance of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association)

text: 更别说，近几年动不动就看到说40多岁的某某明星、大厂中高管离世…
en: Not to mention that in recent years one constantly sees news of some forty-something celebrity or senior manager at a big firm passing away…

text: 我们这种有些小毛小病但还活蹦乱跳地活着的脆皮中年人，已经算有福的了。
en: We fragile middle-aged folk, with our minor ailments yet still living and kicking, already count as blessed.

text: 所以，人这辈子真是没办法一直享福的。
en: So, in this life one truly cannot enjoy good fortune forever.

text: 该吃的苦，永远在某个转角处等着你。
en: The suffering that must be borne always waits for you round some corner.

text: 要不就是出身苦，辛苦打拼熬出头才能享受后半辈子的福；要不就是年轻的时候没钱痛快地吃喝玩乐，有钱了可以吃喝玩乐了却没有能经得起吃喝玩乐的健康身子了。
en: Either you are born into hardship and must struggle bitterly to rise before you can enjoy the latter half of life; or you are young without money to eat, drink and make merry freely, and by the time you have money to do so, you no longer have a body healthy enough to withstand such indulgence.

text: 一代人有一代人的脆皮。
en: Each generation has its own fragility.

text: 如今，我算是真真切切地体会到属于中年人的脆皮了。
en: Now, I can say I have truly and deeply experienced the fragility that belongs to middle age.
